rule: a command source that names an agent app's login file outside a refusal list
why: An agent app's own login is never held, read or moved. One line of code joins a profile's .credentials.json to open it and is the one finding. The same names in comments, in a test, and in the two refusal lists sync.ts keeps are no finding, so the gate is shown to read code, to allow a refusal list it names and nothing else.
